The report highlights risks to India's credibility.

author: MAITREE BARAL
description: A 70-year-old woman, a breast cancer survivor, faced a new battle with pancreatic cancer. Despite her age and existing health conditions, she underwent a complex robotic-assisted Whipple procedure. Her remarkable recovery and the unwavering support of her family allowed her to reclaim life's milestones, including her upcoming 50th wedding anniversary.
title: Twice a cancer survivor, invites her doctor to her 50th wedding anniversary celebration

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: PwC global chairman Mohamed Kande revealed that 56% of companies are failing to see results from AI investments due to a lack of foundational groundwork.  CEOs now face immense pressure to simultaneously manage existing operations, transform processes, and build new business models, with AI being a significant driver of this complex challenge.
title: 56% of firms see no AI gains, says PwC Global chairman; advises to focus on basics

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Google's top sustainability executive highlights the US electrical grid as a major hurdle for tech companies, causing years of data center connection delays.  To counter this, Google is pursuing a 'co-location' strategy, building data centers near power plants.  This comes as global electricity demand, fueled by data centers and AI, is projected to surge significantly.
title: Challenge for US tech cos: Google exec warns bottlenecks slow data center growth

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Ravichandran Ashwin expressed concern over Kuldeep Yadav's confidence ahead of the T20 World Cup following a challenging ODI series against New Zealand. Ashwin urged Kuldeep to experiment more against in-form batters like Daryl Mitchell, who exploited the spinner's predictability. He also suggested both Indian spinners need to expand their game creatively.
title: ‘Confidence takes a hit’: Ashwin flags major T20 WC test; India stunned by NZ loss

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A US citizen was forcibly removed from his Minnesota home in his underwear by federal immigration agents who allegedly broke down his door without a warrant. The agents detained him at gunpoint, photographed him in frigid weather, and later released him after realizing he was a US citizen with no criminal record. He plans to file a civil rights lawsuit.
title: 'I was shaking': Man pulled from Minnesota home in underwear by ICE

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: The BCCI is considering a major overhaul of its central contracts, potentially scrapping the Grade A+ category. This move could see senior players like Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma, now focusing on ODIs, placed in Grade B. The proposed three-tier system aims to align contracts with workload and format involvement.
title: No more A+ category? BCCI plans contract overhaul; Kohli, Rohit likely to drop

author: PRATYUSH RAJ
description: Tilak Varma is closing in on full fitness and will report to the BCCI’s Centre of Excellence for assessment. Ruled out of the first three T20Is against New Zealand, the India No. 3 could return for the fourth match. Team India's ODI vice-captain Shreyas Iyer has been added as cover meanwhile.
title: Tilak Varma update: Batter to reach BCCI CoE today; getting closer to regaining full fitness

author: TIMESOFINDIA.COM
description: Toyota has launched the Urban Cruiser Ebella, its first mass-market electric SUV, sharing its platform with the Maruti Suzuki e-Vitara. Bookings are open for Rs 25,000, with an 8-year battery warranty and buyback options. The Ebella offers two battery choices, up to 543 km range, and advanced features like Level 2 ADAS and a 10.1-inch infotainment system.
title: Toyota Urban Cruiser Ebella EV bookings open: Design, range, features & more

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: President Trump threatened to impose tariffs on European nations if a deal for Greenland isn't reached, stating he would "100%" proceed. He also linked his stance to the Nobel Peace Prize decision, claiming Denmark cannot protect Greenland. Greenland's Prime Minister asserted the territory's right to self-determination.

author: TOI Education
description: The UK’s new international education strategy signals a quiet but significant shift for overseas students. By dropping student-number targets and tightening compliance, the government is moving from growth to control. While Britain remains open, the welcome feels more conditional, introducing uncertainty around visas, access, and long-term opportunities for international learners.
title: UK drops international student targets in new strategy

author: SMITA MISHRA
description: A sudden Leptospirosis diagnosis plunged a family into crisis, revealing a critical flaw in their insurance policy. Despite a substantial coverage, the hospital was out-of-network, forcing an immediate scramble for funds.  Office support ultimately bridged the gap, highlighting the vital role of timely assistance during emergencies.

author: TOI NEWS DESK
description: The BJP on Monday declared Nabin as its sole candidate for the post after the nomination and scrutiny process concluded without any rival contenders. This cleared the path for his unopposed election as the party’s 12th national president. In a late-night statement, BJP National Returning Officer K. Laxman said that only Nabin’s name remained after the completion of nominations and the withdrawal window, confirming his election by consensus.
title: From party worker to its president: Nitin Nabin becomes BJP's youngest chief — 10 things to know

author: TOI NEWS DESK
description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi declared Nitin Nabin his "boss" as the party worker after Nabin, the BJP's youngest-ever national president at 45, assumed office. PM Modi highlighted Nabin's millennial status, emphasizing his blend of youthful energy and organizational experience as crucial for building a developed India over the next 25 years.
title: 'Nitin Nabin is my boss': PM Modi congratulates new BJP chief; calls himself a 'party worker'

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: Gold and silver prices reached record highs Tuesday, driven by fears of a US-EU trade war following US President Trump's tariff threats. Investors sought safe-haven assets amid heightened global uncertainty. Both metals saw significant gains on MCX and in international markets, with silver hitting a lifetime high.

author: TOI NEWS DESK
description: Rahul Gandhi's 'TINA' jibe, meaning 'There Is No Accountability,' targeted the government following a techie's tragic death in a Greater Noida pit. The 27-year-old engineer's family claims repeated warnings about the accident-prone site were ignored.  Authorities have filed an FIR against developers and formed an SIT to investigate the incident and rescue delays.
title: ‘Roads kill, bridges kill, fires kill’: Rahul Gandhi reacts to Noida techie death

author: SANJAY SHARMA
description: The Supreme Court questioned the Delhi government over the hurried mid-year implementation of the Delhi School Education (Transparency in Fixation and Regulation of Fees) Act, 2025, expressing concern that retrospective enforcement could cause confusion and financial strain for private unaided schools. While backing the welfare objective of fee regulation, the court flagged missed statutory timelines, cautioned against retrospective fee fixation, and asked the government to clarify its approach. The matter will be heard again.
title: SC questions Delhi government over hurried mid-year school fee regulation law

author: PRANTIK PRABAL ROY
description: John Harbaugh’s arrival marks a defining shift for the New York Giants as the franchise embraces experience and stability. After nearly two decades in Baltimore, Harbaugh steps into New York with renewed purpose, supported by his family and a young, promising roster, fueling optimism about a disciplined rebuild and a competitive future.
title: John Harbaugh’s wife Ingrid turns heads during Giants’ headline-making entrance

author: ANUJA JAISWAL
description: The WHO warns that alcohol and sugar-sweetened beverages are becoming more affordable in India due to weak tax designs, failing to curb consumption despite strong health links. This public-health failure is leading to rising rates of liver disease, diabetes, and other chronic illnesses, particularly among younger populations.
title: Alcohol, sugary drinks stay cheap in India as WHO flags weak taxes in South-East Asia

author: TOI NEWS DESK
description: Tamil Nadu Governor RN Ravi staged a walkout from the state assembly, citing disrespect for the National Anthem and his microphone being switched off. Raj Bhavan alleged the speech ignored critical issues like Dalit atrocities. This marks a repeat of a similar incident last year, intensifying political tensions ahead of upcoming elections.
title: High drama in TN assembly: Governor walks out; alleges 'national anthem insulted', 'mic switched off'

author: GAURAV GUPTA
description: India's ODI home series loss to New Zealand has put veteran players Ravindra Jadeja and Rohit Sharma under scrutiny. Jadeja's wicketless streak and batting struggles raise concerns, while Rohit's future in the 2027 World Cup is debated despite recent good form, impacting younger talent like Yashasvi Jaiswal.
title: IND vs NZ: What next for Jadeja, Rohit? Veteran stars had a poor ODI outing

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Danish and Greenlandic protesters are using "Make America Go Away" caps, a parody of Trump's MAGA hats, to voice opposition to his Greenland acquisition ambitions.  These symbolic hats, gaining traction online and at rallies, highlight a united front against perceived US threats to Arctic security and Danish sovereignty.  The movement underscores a strong desire to support Greenland.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Denmark has bolstered its military presence in Greenland with additional troops amid rising tensions following US President Trump's threats to acquire the Arctic territory.  This deployment coincides with a US announcement of an aircraft to Pituffik Space Base, a move cleared diplomatically. Trump continues to push for Greenland's acquisition, citing national security and threatening tariffs.
title: More Danish troops in Greenland? Videos show fresh deployment amid Trump’s threat

author: MAITREE BARAL
description: Doctors are increasingly concerned about fatty liver disease in children, a condition linked to obesity and metabolic issues. This silent condition can lead to serious long-term health problems, including cardiovascular disease, even in young individuals. Early detection and lifestyle changes are crucial for reversing the damage and supporting liver health.
title: Not baby fat: Extra weight can harm a child’s liver, warns doctor

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: The Indian rupee continued its downward slide, nearing historic lows against the US dollar. Persistent demand from metal importers and foreign fund outflows are key drivers. Geopolitical uncertainties, including US trade threats and domestic equity weakness, are fueling risk aversion and pressuring the rupee. Analysts anticipate continued pressure, with the currency hovering near record lows.
title: Rupee in red: Currency falls 8 paisa in early trade; reaches 90.98 against US dollar

author: TNN
description: The heartbreaking drowning of a software engineer in an overflown, decade-old trench underscores a serious lapse in stormwater management over the years. Although funding and blueprints were set in 2015 to build a vital water-diverting regulator for the Hindon River, this life-saving project has yet to materialize, leading to devastating flooding that has affected numerous housing developments.

Miami's backcourt is depleted, placing more pressure on Bam Adebayo and Norman Powell. Golden State, despite missing key players, is favored at home, with Draymond Green's status being crucial for their defensive edge.
title: Heat vs Warriors injury report: Injured & questionable players, stats and more

author: CHAITANYA MARPAKWAR
description: The tussle for the Mumbai mayor's post continues as the state government issues a notification for the reservation lottery on January 22, with elections likely on January 31. Deputy CM Shinde assures the mayor will be from the Mahayuti alliance, emphasizing respect for public mandate and development for Mumbaikars.

author: GAURAV GUPTA

Despite a Champions Trophy win, the team has faltered in Test and ODI formats, raising questions ahead of the T20 World Cup. Gambhir's tenure has seen mixed results, with some strategic decisions proving beneficial.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Iran grapples with its worst crisis in decades amidst widespread protests, a brutal crackdown, and an ongoing internet shutdown. State TV broadcasts were disrupted, showing support for an exiled prince.  Thousands are reported dead, with fears of executions rising. International pressure mounts as Iran faces a Davos snub, while US aircraft carrier movements near the Middle East heighten regional tensions.

description: Josh Allen became a viral talking point after Buffalo’s playoff loss to Denver, with fans mixing football frustration and pop culture humor. Social media tied his overtime mistake to buzz around his fiancée Hailee Steinfeld, creating jokes that blended the Bills’ early exit with Hollywood references, turning postseason heartbreak into internet comedy.

description: Kamchatka Peninsula in Russia is grappling with unprecedented snowfall, burying homes and roads under metres of snow. Transport remains severely disrupted as residents battle extraordinary winter conditions.

He vows to fight for justice, citing institutional failure and questioning the preparedness of emergency services in this tragic incident.

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Ajinkya Rahane criticises excessive team changes and lack of clarity under Gautam Gambhir, citing India's recent ODI series losses. Rahane believes a scheduling break offers a chance for management to reset and back the right combination.

CCTV footage captured the shocking incident, leading to Naveen's arrest and the seizure of his vehicle.

description: Virat Kohli's stellar 124 against New Zealand, despite India's series loss, drew praise from his brother, Vikas Kohli. Kohli's recent form, including multiple centuries, underscores his continued dominance in the format.
